privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.notice: Template text. This document must be reviewed and replaced by the operator's legal counsel before launch.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information the AEDST marketing site collects and how it is used.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.body: This site does not require an account and does not set tracking cookies. Our servers keep standard technical logs such as IP address, time and requested page.

s2.title: Analytics
s2.body: Optional analytics are not active on this site. If they are added, they will run only after you give consent.

s3.title: Your account in the app
s3.body: When you sign in to the AEDST app, the app's own privacy policy applies to the data you store there.

s4.title: Contact
s4.body: The operator's contact details for privacy requests will be published here before launch.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.notice: Template text. These terms must be reviewed and replaced by the operator's legal counsel before launch.
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the AEDST marketing site.

s1.title: Use of the site
s1.body: You may browse this site for lawful purposes. Do not attempt to disrupt it or access it in unauthorised ways.

s2.title: Content
s2.body: The content of this site is provided for information only. Plans and prices shown are placeholders and may change.

s3.title: The AEDST app
s3.body: Use of the signed-in app is governed by the terms presented when you create an account.

s4.title: Changes
s4.body: We may update these terms. The date at the top of the page shows the latest revision.
